name: Telnyx Power Dialer - Production AMD Transfer

parameters.jsCode:
return [{
  json: {
    TELNYX_API_KEY: 'PASTE_API_KEY_HERE',
    TELNYX_CONNECTION_ID: 'PASTE_CONNECTION_ID_HERE',
    FROM_NUMBER_POOL: ['+1214XXXXXXX', '+1201XXXXXXX'],
    TRANSFER_TO_NUMBER: '+1XXXXXXXXXX',
    MAX_CONCURRENT_CALLS: 3,
    MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_LEAD: 5,
    COOLDOWN_MINUTES: 60,
    WEBHOOK_TOKEN: 'SET_A_RANDOM_TOKEN_HERE',
    DEBUG_MODE: true,
    TELNYX_API_BASE_URL: 'https://api.telnyx.com/v2',
    AMD_MODE: 'detect',
    ENFORCE_ALLOWED_HOURS: false,
    ALLOWED_HOURS_START_LOCAL: 8,
    ALLOWED_HOURS_END_LOCAL: 20,
    WEBHOOK_PATH: 'telnyx-power-dialer',
  },
}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ ({ connection_id: $('CONFIG').first().json.TELNYX_CONNECTION_ID, to: $json.lead_phone, from: $json.chosen_from, answering_machine_detection: $('CONFIG').first().json.AMD_MODE || 'detect', client_state: $json.client_state, command_id: $json.command_id }) }}
